_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform, discovered by the same `testContributionDirName` convention as the shared ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🧪️oracle/🔣️.json — a mutation vocabulary belongs to one subset of one standard of one artifact, so its oracle registration lives here rather than in the shared, format-spanning manifest.

oracles.rationale: Distinct from the shared `gif` oracle entry's `gif-raster` capability (single-frame creation): this entry's `gif-89a-mutate` capability is this subset's full 21-kind mutation vocabulary — screen/GCT/loop scalars, frame insert/remove/move/geometry/pixels/interlace/delay/disposal/transparency/user-input, and comment/app-extension insert/remove — applied and re-serialized with the same reference encoder/decoder, plus minimal fixed-offset header patching for the two scalar fields (background color index, pixel aspect ratio) `gif::Encoder`'s public API has no setter for.
